title: Give `WORKSPACE` toolchains and platforms precedence over non-root modules

timeline.body:
RELNOTES[INC]: Toolchains and execution platforms are now registered in the following order with `--enable_bzlmod`:
1. root module's module file
2. `WORKSPACE` or `WORKSPACE.bzlmod`
3. non-root modules' module files
4. default toolchains registered by Bazel (does not apply with `WORKSPACE.bzlmod` or execution platforms)

Fixes #20354
What is a good place to document this behavior?
Probably should be a part of https://bazel.build/external/migration

Overall looks good! Thank you so much!

Can you please add a few sentence here: https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/master/site/en/external/migration.md#register-toolchains--execution-platforms-register-toolchains to document this behaviour? 🙏🏼

Does this patch fix the repro in #20354 ? I tried and it did not for me so it either doesn't work or there is something more sinister going on.

Out of desperation, I tried `bazel clean --expunge` in between but that (as expected) did not change anything. I also tried at `51bddee96bc357d8131efba606420227c7a8ebc5` (Nov 16) and the reproduction tickles the bug, so I guess it inadvertently got fixed sometime in between?
Can you try with the latest RC for bazel 7?

@lberki I think that https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/48eb0236b2f65babf3dd9c314069774a78b629a3 fixes the reproducer at HEAD by removing the Bzlmod side of the conflicting toolchain registration.
I added docs and also applied these rules to execution platforms, which luckily don't appear in WORKSPACE suffixes and are thus much easier to handle.

This is tracking the index inside registeredToolchains of where the root module ends?

This need a comment explaining that, and why that's being done.

timeline.author: Fabian Meumertzheim

diff.patch:
@@ -453,6 +453,19 @@ toolchain.
     register_toolchains("@local_config_sh//:local_sh_toolchain")
     ```
 
+The toolchains and execution platforms registered in `WORKSPACE`,
+`WORKSPACE.bzlmod` and each Bazel module's `MODULE.bazel` file follow this
+order of precedence during toolchain selection (from highest to lowest):
+
+1. toolchains and execution platforms registered in the root module's
+   `MODULE.bazel` file.
+2. toolchains and execution platforms registered in the `WORKSPACE` or
+   `WORKSPACE.bzlmod` file.
+3. toolchains and execution platforms registered by modules that are
+   (transitive) dependencies of the root module.
+4. when not using `WORKSPACE.bzlmod`: toolchains registered in the `WORKSPACE`
+   [suffix]((/external/migration#builtin-default-deps).
+
 [register_execution_platforms]: /rules/lib/globals/module#register_execution_platforms
 
 ### Introduce local repositories {:#introduce-local-deps}
